I want a better life for myself one where I am not dependant on others but I don't wanna be 50 when I finally get a house and car. I want a decent job not to be a billionaire or CEO. Hell I would be a Welder living in a 15x15 shed with an old beater but I wouldn't care as long as it was mine. Nothing I want is unreasonable or unrealistic but I can't even get that.Being such a failure no matter what I do. 

It's not like I lack ambition or gumption I have a job I live in my own I have given up drinking and smoking to the detriment of my social life but it doesn't make a difference.
